title: A focused test whose launcher records are consistent is recorded "Test Unknown: interval validation rejected (early run.ended < observed_start)" when the host observes the command start after the run already ended
outcome: A test or build check whose launcher records are internally consistent keeps its real verdict (Passed or Failed) when the only discrepancy is host-observation latency, including the case where the host first observes the command after the launcher's run has ended. Genuinely inconsistent intervals still reject, and the refusal names the failed comparison.
acceptance: A focused test whose launcher records are consistent is recorded "Test Unknown: interval validation rejected (early run.ended < observed_start)" when the host observes the command start after the run already ended is done
